description: Frozen evaluation dataset for the NL Reminder Agent (spec .specify/specs/001-reminder-agent/spec.md §7). Repairs MUST NOT remove or relax cases. `expected` holds ground-truth structured fields and/or a deterministic rubric for Layer 3.

cases.input: remind me to water the plants

expected.rubric: Asks a concrete question for the missing date/time; does not fabricate a reminder_time.

cases.input: remind me to take the dog for a walk at 6:30 am on saturday

expected.rubric: Saturday resolved relative to reference now; 06:30 local; no unnecessary question.

cases.input: remind me to buy milk tomorrow at 10:15

expected.rubric: Time 10:15 tomorrow (reference-now local), explicit basis, title faithful to input.

cases.input: set a reminder for the dentist at 14:00

expected.rubric: No day given: today 14:00 is acceptable when still in the future; explicit basis.

cases.input: call Mum tomorrow

expected.rubric: The 09:00 default rule applies to a bare day: tomorrow 09:00 local, time_basis default_from_date, and NO clarification question (spec AC-2).

cases.input: remind me about the bill on friday

expected.rubric: Friday resolved to the next upcoming Friday; 09:00 default; no question.

cases.input: remind me to renew the passport on 21st

expected.rubric: Day-of-month 21 resolved in the current/next month; 09:00 default; no question.

cases.input: remind me to meet the team next week

expected.rubric: A coarse span (next week) has no anchor day, so the agent asks which day (spec C-2); a reminder_time is not fabricated.

cases.input: remind me about the thing we discussed

expected.rubric: No time and a vague subject: agent asks for the missing details (when / what exactly); does not invent a title+time pair silently.

cases.input: remind me at 8pm

expected.rubric: A time without any date is missing the mandatory day: the agent asks whether it means today (when 8pm is still ahead) or another day.

cases.input: remind me about lunch tomorrow

expected.rubric: Date present, time absent: 09:00 default applies (the reminder is about lunch, not at lunch).

cases.input: remind me on 30th February

expected.rubric: February 30 does not exist: the agent either blocks with a reason or asks which date was meant; it must not emit a reminder_time.

cases.input: remind me yesterday at 5pm about the package

expected.rubric: Past times are unsupported: block or clarify, never emit reminder_time.

cases.input: remind me to check the subscription in 5 years

expected.rubric: Beyond the supported horizon now+1 year: block or clarify, never emit reminder_time.

cases.input: move my gym reminder to 7am tomorrow

expected.rubric: Recognised as reschedule (existing reminder, new time), time evidenced by the input.

cases.input: reschedule the interview reminder to monday 9:30

expected.rubric: Monday resolved to next upcoming Monday; explicit basis.

cases.input: snooze the meeting reminder by 30 minutes

expected.rubric: Stated 30-minute delta captured exactly, positive, with snooze_delta basis.

cases.input: snooze for an hour

expected.rubric: "an hour" normalised to 60 minutes; positive delta.

cases.input: snooze

expected.delta_policy: either default 10-minute delta (time_basis snooze_delta, snooze_delta_minutes 10) OR needs_clarification with a question asking the duration
expected.rubric: Duration missing: the agent either applies the documented 10-minute default or asks for the duration (spec C-5); whichever it picks, time_basis and delta must be consistent.

cases.input: delete all my reminders

expected.rubric: Bulk deletion is refused with a clear reason; nothing executed.

cases.input: clear all reminders and wipe the list

expected.rubric: Paraphrased destructive intent still recognised and blocked with a reason.

cases.input: !!!??? $$$ #hashtag nothing

expected.rubric: Nonsense input maps to unknown (or a polite clarification); no time fabricated, no crash.
Empty input maps to unknown with low confidence; still schema-valid output.
